name: Nooks
positioning: Revenue Agent Platform / revenue infrastructure for reps and agents: AI prospecting, dialing, sequencing, deal follow-up, coaching, with Nooks Labs research on long-horizon agents. Self-label: Revenue Agent Platform; execution layer for humans + AI agents.

recent.title: $500M General Catalyst CVF + Node (AI sales assistant) + Revenue Agent Platform
recent.summary: Nov 4 blog (Dan Lee) + PR Newswire: GC Customer Value Fund commits $500M non-dilutive growth capital (repaid from customer value). Launches Node — proactive AI personal assistant for sales / "EA for the AE"; deal management first; reps approve sends; early access now, GA early 2027. Unifies Revenue Agent Platform: Deal, Outbound, Expansion, Coaching Agents live; Inbound Agents Q1 2027. Claims: 2,000+ companies (Glean, Notion, Deel, Factory, Replit), ~3× YoY growth, 135% NRR, 96% agent emails unedited, early Node users up to 80% productivity / ~2 hrs/day saved (method not detailed). Also: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/nooks-secures-500-million-from-general-catalyst-and-launches-node-the-first-ai-personal-assistant-for-sales-302928795.html

recent.title: Nooks Labs: Cracking the hard problem — sales agents that actually work
recent.summary: Nooks Labs technical post (Narahari Bharadwaj): why coding-agent playbooks fail for sales (fact resolution, strategy selection, style/taste). Claims SalesBench Verified accuracy lift to 72–79%, 96% of emails sent autonomously without edits, and ~2x meetings booked per rep for internal team / early beta. First in a series.

recent.title: CMO Loreal Lynch on GTM Now podcast — stop counting agents per rep
recent.summary: Company blog recap of GTM Now podcast: expects AI to prompt reps within 1–2 years; frames 10x productivity as a hiring argument; stresses infrastructure (data, governance, dialing) as the hard part of scaling agents.

recent.title: Homepage: 'Revenue infrastructure for reps and agents'; Nooks Labs
recent.summary: As of 2026-09-27, nooks.ai positions as one execution layer across outbound/inbound/deal/expansion/coaching; highlights Nooks Labs applied AI research trained on 1B+ sales interactions; AI Prospecting/Dialing/Sequencing product pillars.

recent.title: Acquires FullyRamped; Aaron Marks joins Product
recent.summary: PR Newswire Aug 26: Nooks acquires FullyRamped (AI sales coaching / roleplay voice agents). Founder Aaron Marks joins Nooks Product. CEO Dan Lee frames Revenue Agent Platform spanning lifecycle beyond outbound. Company blog dated Aug 25: https://www.nooks.ai/blog-posts/nooks-acquires-fullyramped. Claims 1,800+ companies (Deel, Intercom, HubSpot, Rippling, Miro, Replit).

notes: Nov 4: major triple announce — $500M GC CVF, Node early access (GA early 2027), Revenue Agent Platform. Prior FullyRamped Aug 26 and Nooks Labs Sep 24 remain background.
